provenance.method: read-only extraction of every McpTool literal's name, description and input_schema; v1 source was never copied into this tree (ARCHIVE-MAP evidence rule)
provenance.note: input_schema below is v1's schema, recorded as evidence of what v1 promised. A REGISTERED tool's schema is the v2 method's own params (see specs.go); the two are compared by hand, never by machine, because a v2 method is not obliged to take v1's arguments.

tools.v1_description: Read a cascade tier instruction file (CASCADE.md / CLAUDE.md) from the specified tier. Returns the full file text.
tools.name: cascade_context_show

tools.v1_description: Hybrid RAG search (FTS5 + dense vector + RRF) across the watched corpus. Returns ranked chunks with citations (file, line, score).
tools.name: cascade_context_search

tools.v1_description: Code-aware search using tree-sitter function-level index. Returns matching functions/classes with exact file:line citations.
tools.reason: internal/repo builds a SymbolGraph for reachability only; it exposes no symbol-search entry point and no tree-sitter function index

tools.v1_description: List PCI inbox messages for a project.
tools.reason: cascade_inbox_list is a compact-profile name AK/S-73.T3 owns; internal/notify.Inbox is in-daemon memory with no RPC namespace

tools.v1_description: Send a PCI message to a project inbox.
tools.reason: the mutating counterpart is cascade_cpa_send in the compact-write profile, which AK/S-73.T3 owns

tools.v1_description: Read a project master list (routes, components, tables, endpoints, CLI commands, env vars, etc.).
tools.reason: v2 has no project master-list surface; the concept did not survive the clean-sheet rewrite

tools.v1_description: Read a project memory file (decisions, lessons, patterns).
tools.reason: v1 read a project memory FILE by (project, file); v2's store is record-addressed by (kind, name) and has no file-path surface

tools.v1_description: Append an entry to a project memory file. Requires an authenticated connection (HMAC token).
tools.reason: v1 APPENDED to a project memory file; v2's memory.remember writes a whole record, which is a different operation and needs its own schema decision

tools.v1_description: Return a token-budgeted, deduplicated, windowed context slice from the local knowledge base for injection into a harness prompt. Applies shell-output compression, within-window chunk dedup, and optionally cross-session dedup.

query.description: Natural-language query to retrieve context for

budget_tokens.description: Maximum token count to include in the returned context slice

session_id.description: Opaque harness session ID for cross-session dedup. Omit to disable cross-session dedup.

include_shell.description: If true, include shell-output compression pass on any embedded shell snippets.

tools.name: cascade_context_slice

tools.v1_description: ONE-CALL harness bootstrap (E-P7-01). A harness calls this once on startup and receives everything it needs: the resolved 6-tier merged instructions for the given cwd, the applicable policy set, harness-specific config, the MCP server coordinates, and the live active-work context (active sprint tickets + open kanban tasks). No per-tier file reconciliation required in the harness — cascade owns all merging. (E-P8-07: active_work field)

cwd.description: Absolute path of the working directory the harness is operating in

tools.name: cascade_context_sync

tools.v1_description: Return current.yaml active pointers: active phase/epic/wave/sprint and active ticket IDs. Bounded to <=200 tokens for session-boot use. Accepts an optional phases_root override; defaults to CWD walk.

phases_root.description: Absolute path to the phases/ directory. Defaults to CWD auto-discovery.

tools.reason: the PBD phase tree is plugins/pbd's; internal/mcp must not import plugins/**, and no pbd.* RPC namespace is registered

tools.v1_description: Transition a ticket to a new status. Validates the transition against the TicketStatus enum (planned|queue|active|review|blocked|done|archived) and writes an event to events.jsonl. Returns the new status on success.

phases_root.description: Absolute path to the phases/ directory. Defaults to CWD auto-discovery.

tools.reason: same: no pbd.* RPC namespace exists for internal/mcp to dispatch into

tools.v1_description: Append a raw PBD event record to events.jsonl. The record is validated for required fields (ts, actor, level, id, from, to) before appending. Use cascade.update_ticket_status for ticket transitions — this tool is for custom/manual events.

event.description: PBD event object: {ts, actor, level, id, from, to, note?}

phases_root.description: Absolute path to the phases/ directory. Defaults to CWD auto-discovery.

tools.v1_description: Return the sprint YAML for the given sprint ID. Searches the active phase tree for the sprint. Returns sprint metadata including tickets list.

phases_root.description: Absolute path to the phases/ directory. Defaults to CWD auto-discovery.

tools.v1_description: Return a compact status summary for the given phase (or all non-archived phases if phase_id is omitted). Includes ticket counts per status.

phase_id.description: Phase ID (e.g. p1). Omit to get all active phases.

phases_root.description: Absolute path to the phases/ directory. Defaults to CWD auto-discovery.

tools.v1_description: List tickets across the phase tree with optional filters. Returns ticket ID, title, status, sprint, and repo. Filters are AND-combined.

sprint_id.description: Filter to a specific sprint ID

phase_id.description: Filter to a specific phase ID

phases_root.description: Absolute path to the phases/ directory. Defaults to CWD auto-discovery.

tools.v1_description: Run a check over api-routes.yaml if present in the project. Returns per-route ok/fail status. HTTP client is injectable for tests (no network required in test mode).

routes_file.description: Absolute path to api-routes.yaml. Defaults to CWD/.claude/docs/api-routes.yaml.

base_url.description: Base URL override for all route checks (e.g. http://localhost:3000)

tools.reason: v2 has no api-routes.yaml checker, and the tool issued outbound HTTP, which needs an egress class before it can be exposed to a model

tools.v1_description: Drain .claude/inbox (or <ai-folder>/inbox) for CI/CD error messages and PCI messages. Returns summaries of all .md files found: filename, first line (subject), and size. Does not delete files.

inbox_path.description: Absolute path to the inbox directory. Defaults to CWD auto-discovery.

tools.reason: v1 drained a filesystem inbox directory; v2 routes notifications through internal/notify with no such directory

tools.v1_description: Scan git-tracked files (or a single file) for leaked secrets and credentials. Returns structured findings with kind, file, line, redacted preview, and severity. Client-side paths (browser-visible code) are flagged at high severity even when the pattern baseline is lower.

path.description: Absolute path to a file or directory to scan. Defaults to the current working directory. For directories, only git-tracked files are scanned.

tools.reason: internal/secrets ships a content Detector, not a repository scanner; there is no scan entry point to dispatch into

tools.v1_description: Run a dependency audit against the project at `path`. Auto-detects the ecosystem (Cargo → cargo audit, npm/pnpm → pnpm audit, Python → pip-audit). Returns advisories with id, package, severity, and title. Returns tool_available:false when the audit tool is not installed — never errors the MCP call.

path.description: Absolute path to the project directory. Defaults to the current working directory.

tools.reason: v2 runs its dependency audit in CI (the supply-chain lane), not through an in-process surface a tool could call

tools.v1_description: Insert an episode or fact into the specified memory namespace. Namespace must be 'personal' (requires opt_in=true), 'meta', or 'dev-<project-slug>'. Personal namespace is blocked without opt_in.

content.description: Text content of the episode to remember

opt_in.description: Required to access 'personal' namespace. Default false.

tools.name: cascade_memory_remember

tools.v1_description: Query memory in the specified namespace. Returns matching episodes and facts ordered by relevance. Namespace-scoped — no cross-namespace leakage. Personal namespace requires opt_in=true.

query.description: Natural language query to search memory

opt_in.description: Required to access 'personal' namespace. Default false.

tools.name: cascade_memory_recall

tools.v1_description: Archive or delete a memory episode or fact by id within a namespace. Personal namespace requires opt_in=true. Episodes are hard-deleted; facts are soft-archived (archived=true).

id.description: UUID of the episode or fact to forget

kind.description: Whether to forget an episode or a fact

opt_in.description: Required to access 'personal' namespace. Default false.

tools.name: cascade_memory_forget

tools.v1_description: Semantic search within a memory namespace. Returns episodes and facts matching the query. Identical to recall but named for discoverability. Personal namespace requires opt_in=true.

opt_in.description: Required to access 'personal' namespace. Default false.

tools.name: cascade_memory_search
